warnings: *** THE ACCESSIBLE BATHROOM, AND THE ONE PLACE IN THE SET WHERE THE WHEELCHAIR IS DRAWN AND DIMENSIONED. *** A dashed 1.50 m circle labelled 'เส้นประแสดงรัศมีหมุนรถเข็น ø1.50m.' occupies the middle of the room, with a wheelchair drawn beside grab rail H4. A-03 states the principle but never this number.

The 0.02 m drop from the โถง (+0.40) into the bathroom (+0.38) is handled with a 10 cm bevel running the full door width -- 'ลาดเอียง กว้าง 10 ซม ยาวตลอด' -- rather than a threshold, exactly as A-03 demands ('ไม่ควรมีธรณีประตู').

FOUR MARKS H, H2, H3, H4 ARE USED IN THIS ONE ROOM AND NONE IS DEFINED HERE -- RESOLVED LATER BY A-29 (PNG 31), WHICH OVERTURNED THE READING TAKEN ON THIS SHEET. The natural reading, that all four are grab rails, is wrong: only H2 and H3 are (A-26 details them). H is a chrome TOWEL RAIL at 1.50 m, and H4 is a movable height-adjustable SHOWER SEAT which A-29 marks 'เจ้าของจัดหาเอง' -- owner-supplied, outside the contract. That is why the object drawn beside the wheelchair here is chair-shaped, and why A-26 details H1/H2/H3 but never H4.

SEVERAL FIXTURE MARKS ARE LEFT UNEXPANDED on this sheet -- SP, K, S, PH -- and A-29 (PNG 31) settles all four. SP is a SOAP DISH ('ที่วางสบู่'), which the reading taken here got WRONG (it guessed a water outlet from the wall position). K is a lever floor-washing tap, S a chrome bidet spray and PH a wall-mounted paper holder -- those three were read correctly.
The room is 2.30 x 3.40 m internally with wall finish 2 (ceramic tile) tagged all round, floor 2 and ceiling 2 -- the only 2/2/2 room in the house.
The fixture set-out is fully dimensioned in the letter direction (0.40 / 0.80 / 0.80 / 0.80 / 0.50 / 0.50 = 3.40), so every fixture position is recoverable.
Sections A and B are cut from here to A-25.
